name: NeoAnki2
subtitle: Study with spaced repetition
description:
Build a study library that works the way you think. NeoAnki2 is a native flashcard and spaced-repetition app for iPhone and iPad.

Create your own study items with text, cloze deletions, images, audio, and video. Organize them into decks and choose how each card presents its question and answer. Guided builders help you prepare vocabulary, poems, and prose for practice.

Study at your own pace with adaptive spaced repetition. Review answers, grade your recall, and record spoken responses. Keep track of due cards, set optional daily reminders, and use the Due Cards widget to return to your study library.

Your library works offline. Optional iCloud sync keeps supported library content, media, and imported vocabulary packs in your private Apple iCloud database. Pack catalogs sync across your devices; download dictionary files when you need them for offline use. Import and export NeoAnki2 deck files to move your work between devices.

Free to use, with no ads or tracking. No NeoAnki2 account is required.

NeoAnki2 uses its own native card and deck formats. It does not import Anki .apkg files or HTML/CSS card templates.
reviewNotes:
NeoAnki2 1.0.1 is a personal offline study app for iPhone and iPad. No app account, sign-in, purchase, subscription, or demo credentials are required. The fresh library is empty; all study content is created or imported by the user.

1. Purpose and audience
Students and independent learners create flashcards, image occlusion, vocabulary, prose, and poem exercises and review them using spaced repetition.

2. Main journey
Open Create, add a Basic item, enter Front and Back, select or create a destination deck, and save. Open that deck and Study, reveal the answer, and grade it. Additional content can be added through the image/audio pickers; cancellation leaves the draft intact. Vocabulary dictionaries can be imported through the system file picker. The app includes no paid content or public user-content sharing service.

3. Permissions and services
Microphone permission is requested only when recording practice. Photos are selected with the system picker. Optional reminders and iCloud sync require explicit opt-in. Local text study works offline. Optional synchronization uses Apple's private CloudKit container; vocabulary pack catalogs and files also synchronize through the user's private CloudKit database. There are no third-party login, analytics, tracking, payment, or AI services.

4. Setup and samples
No external account or sample file is needed for the primary create-and-study journey. Optional iCloud features require an Apple iCloud account. Files imported by the user remain their personal library content.

5. Regions
The empty initial library and features are consistent across regions. Device settings control date/number formatting; iCloud depends on Apple's service availability. There is no regional content unlock.

6. Regulated or third-party material
The app provides no medical, financial, legal, gambling, or other regulated service. No commercial book, poem, music, movie, or dictionary catalog is bundled or streamed. The scheduling implementation is a native Swift port of BSD-3-Clause fsrs-rs. No Anki software is bundled.

This update improves image attachments, occlusion editing, word capture, and study/accessibility behavior. Candidate-specific automated QA evidence is retained with the release; unavailable physical acceptance checks are documented separately and are not reported as performed.
